g.text: Complete this form to send a booking request. Sarah has 24 hours to respond.
Add a payment method to continue
You'll need to add a card before you can send a booking request
Personal care services are available from Tier 2 onwards
Example: I'd like to go for a walk if the weather is nice, o...
This person will be notified if there's an emergency during the booking
• Full refund if cancelled 24+ hours before start time • 50% refund if cancelled less than 24 hours before start • No refund if cancelled within 2 hours of start time
I understand and accept the cancellation policy
